room_cm.note: west wall X 0, east wall X 630, north wall Z 0, the south wall (the doors) at Z 450, cut away: the lens is at (330, 640), 230 cm up, outside the open doors

ryokai.note: OUTSIDE the west wall at the lattice (his feet, behind the `lattice` cut-out): only his face and shoulders show, in its gaps

humsit.note: Mom sitting on the floor before the hum (sit, floor, or kneel): her head below the light's path, so the light passes over her to the hum

ume.note: O-Ume kneeling (as Grandmother Sei kneels: sit.seat "kneel")

ryokai_face.note: his feet outside the west wall; his head shows through the lattice's gaps at this point; the cut-out `lattice` covers the rest of him (its base is the west wall's foot)

lattice.note: the west lattice: five slats, the sunset in the gaps; a cut-out with the west wall (`lattice`)

bars.note: the shafts and bars of light (the live layer: layout.json `bars`); the shape is where they are at the hum's moment

wall.note: the east wall's plain plaster, where the light lands

hum.note: a shimmer in the plaster where a bar of light crosses it (the engine's: nothing painted); the small door opens here

cabinet.note: the small closed cabinet on its stand (a Kannon inside, its doors shut: not shown, not named)

lamp.note: an oil lamp on a short stand, right of the cabinet (unlit: the fx `lamp-flame` if the scene lights it)

incense.note: the bronze incense burner before the cabinet (cold: the fx `incense-smoke` if lit)

flowers.note: flowers in a jar, left of the cabinet: two weeks shut in, they have drooped

slips.note: slips everywhere (448 painted): this shape is the thickest of them, round the altar bay; paper and thin wood, never copper

posts.note: the posts, each pasted with slips (this shape: the east wall's middle post, the nearest)

ceiling.note: the board ceiling on its battens, the beams across with their slips

mats.note: twelve tatami, black-edged; two round straw cushions before the altar

doorway.note: the open doors are BEHIND us (the south wall is cut away): the way out is the bottom edge; the evening lies on the floor near us

desk.note: a low desk where women write their slips: blank slips, an inkstone, brushes

ume.note: O-Ume kneels here, by the way out, watching the hum

planes.note: the whole west wall with the lattice's frame and slats, the gaps clear: everyone in the hall is in front of it; Ryōkai outside is behind it, his face in the gaps
the women's writing desk near us at the left

states.day: back.png and the planes: the hall at sunset (the light is the live layer's: `bars`)
states.dusk: dusk.png (an alt over the whole stage) with lattice-dusk.png and front-dusk.png: after the sun has gone (the bars faded out, the lattice's sky gone to its afterglow, the room a step darker)

bars.what: the sunset's bars of light through the lattice: across the floor and up the east wall, climbing as the sun sinks; three RGBA light pictures, keyed as frames, for the live layer (under the people), screen blend
bars.k: 0 when the family comes in (the sun 10 degrees up), 1 when it is nearly down (2 degrees); the scene tweens it, slowly (the design: the bars climb while they talk)

sun.azimuth: from the WNW, its light 2.5 degrees south of due east across the hall

wall.note: painted at k 0, with the band's part below the floor included (the clip hides it): as it slides up, its foot rises out of the floor and its top climbs the wall, as the real band does. rise_px is measured at the hum; a pixel or two less at the band's far end, more at its near end

floor.move: dx, dy = (k / k_floor) * to, while k < k_floor
floor.note: painted at k 0 (the bars from X 408 to the wall); they slide east into the wall's foot and are gone by k_floor (opacity to 0 over `fade`)

air.opacity: 1 to k 0.8, then down to 0 at k 1 (with the others)
air.note: the shafts in the dusty air, drawn for the hum's moment; and the window's own glow

bars.hum_note: from k_hum the band's top is past the hum (105 cm up): the hum is in the light, and the small door can open
bars.fade_out: when the sun goes (#38 step 6): every bars picture's opacity to 0 over 3 to 4 s, after k reaches 1

hum.note: on the east wall's plaster in the middle of a bar of light, a hand's height up (105 cm); match round twenty's keep: a portal held part open is the shimmer

door.note: the small door: a coin's size (open with scale coin_scale, or a portal of r_coin: strength 0.8, as the Nevada and Rome coin doors), then a hand's (r_hand: a hand and a rice ball through it) when the pink flashlight is on it. `light: true` bends the bars of light with the wall

fx.note: the hum's own shimmer: held part open (as the keep's, open 0.6) once the bar of light is on it (k >= k_hum)
the small door: open(1, { scale: coin_scale }) for the coin, open(1, { scale: 1 }) for the hand

fx.when: only if the scene lights the lamp (it is cold when the doors are opened)

fx.note: motes turning in the light (while k < 1)

notes: The hall at sunset. The light (the bars on the floor and the east wall, the shafts in the air) is NOT in back.png: it is bars-wall/-floor/-air.png on the live layer, moved by k (layout.json `bars`). The hum and the small door are the engine's portals at `hum`/`door`. The way out is the bottom edge (the open doors behind the lens). PAINT-21F.
